commits.subject: core: rewritten SynLZdecompress1() x64 asm to use BSF opcode
commits.body: - just like the pascal version - only slightly faster than FPC pure pascal :)
commits.author: Arnaud Bouchez

 function SynLZdecompress1(src: PAnsiChar; size: integer; dst: PAnsiChar): integer;
 var
-  off: TOffsets; // pointers are faster and use only 32KB on stack
-asm     // rcx=src, edx=size, r8=dest
-        {$ifdef ABIWINX64} // additional registers to preserve
+  off: TOffsets; // 4096 pointers, allocated on the stack
+asm
+        {$ifdef ABIWINX64}
         push    rsi
         push    rdi
-        {$else} // Linux 64-bit ABI
-        mov     r8, rdx
-        mov     rdx, rsi
-        mov     rcx, rdi
+        mov     rsi, rcx               // rsi = src
+        {$else} // System V x86-64: rdi=src, esi=size, rdx=dst
+        mov     r8, rdx                // r8 = dst
+        mov     edx, esi               // edx = compressed size
+        mov     rsi, rdi               // rsi = src
         {$endif ABIWINX64}
         push    rbx
         push    r12
         push    r13
-        movzx   eax, word ptr [rcx]    // rcx=src   eax=result
-        lea     r9, [rcx + rdx]        // r9=src_end

+        lea     r9, [rsi + rdx]        // r9 = src_end

-        mov     r10d, eax
-        and     r10d, $8000
-        jz      @21                   // dest size < 32768
-        movzx   ebx, word ptr [rcx]

commits.subject: db: TSqlDBProxyStatement can now be executed several times
commits.body:
- TSqlDBProxyStatement keeps the whole response of ExecutePrepared in its
  fDataInternalCopy buffer, which was never released before the instance
  destruction: so a second ExecutePrepared on the same instance always raised
  ESqlDBRemote 'Invalid TSqlDBProxyStatement.ExecutePrepared* call', even
  after Reset or ReleaseRows
- overriden ReleaseRows to release the binary buffer and its columns, and
  Reset to also clear UpdateCount - so the usual Bind() + ExecutePrepared +
  Step() + Reset loop works on a single instance, as with other providers
- the ParamsToCommand() check is kept, so executing again without Reset or
  ReleaseRows still raises an explicit exception
- added a statement reuse regression check to TTestExternalDatabase._SynDBRemote

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
